choice_data_list: I really wanted to show you my best...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
Just knowing you tried to get it for me made me happy.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Besides, people learn a great deal from failure.

text_block_list.name: Cesario

If there's a next time,
maybe you'll be able to win it then.

text_block_list.text: It ended in a disappointing result...
